summary.intent: Confirm that CI failures on PR #555 (Phase 60) are infrastructure flakes rather than regressions, and get the PR into a merge-ready state.
summary.outcome: Confirmed both failures are pre-existing flakes via causal proof (no production-code delta) and historical precedent (identical Test 5 failure on main pre-Phase-60). PR #555 is merge-ready with required CI green.

repo: macOS desktop E2E Test 5 (cross-client-sync content detection) has a pre-existing flake on main dating to before Phase 60 — identical failure message 'FUSE mount still shows original content after 120s' seen on commit 541e4c6 (run 28043695361, 2026-06-23).

When the macOS flake triggers, the desktop marks the file for re-resolution but re-resolution never completes (stuck, not slow) — characteristic of a FUSE-T SMB drain/cache stall, not a timeout boundary issue.
The baseChildren warning in updateFolderMetadataAndPublish is pre-existing benign noise appearing in both passing and failing runs — not a regression signal.
Phase 60 changed the desktop resolve path (strict verify, removed skew, EOL enforcement), but the macOS flake predates those changes.
The 'IPNS name not found' log line during Test 5 failure window refers to an unrelated IPNS name, not the file under test — ruled out as causal.

code.finding: SMB backend caching behavior on macOS FUSE-T is documented here; folder-rename leg is already marked optional on macOS for this reason, but content-sync leg is not yet.
Failure point: 'FUSE mount still shows original content after 120s' — the 120s poll window is occasionally exceeded when FUSE-T SMB cache stalls desktop re-resolution.

workflow: A single re-run passing is not sufficient proof of flakiness when a code change touched related paths — must check historical main-branch runs for the same failure signature.
Distinguishing 'desktop resolved but SMB served stale' from 're-resolution never completed' requires tracing the new CID in desktop logs post-marking — the latter rules out SMB cache as the cause.
Causal proof (git diff showing zero production-code delta) combined with historical precedent (same failure on main pre-change) is the strongest flake argument.

friction: Initial flake analysis was overconfident (cited 'no delta since last 3 commits') without checking against the full Phase 60 cutover scope, requiring user pushback to prompt deeper investigation.
The re-run passing once temporarily masked the issue — required pulling historical main-branch CI runs to establish true baseline.
macOS FUSE-T SMB cache stall causes complete re-resolution hangs (not just slowness), making the 120s timeout a red herring and the root cause harder to isolate.
open_items: Fix macOS cross-client-sync flake: options are (1) raise macOS content-sync timeout to ~180s, (2) mark content-sync leg optional/warn like the rename leg, or (3) invalidate the FUSE-T SMB cache between write and read.
Fix web media-preview.spec.ts browser-closed crash flake (pre-existing, tracked in todo).

8 deferred todos from PR #555: replay re-resolve, desktop conflict fail-fast, orphaned-pin unpin, TS RFC3339 parity, ValidityType+vector lockstep, staging-IP scrub, flaky-e2e (now including macOS cross-client-sync with fix options).
Merge decision for PR #555 — no technical blockers remain, awaiting user call.
